doc: The values hdf5_map's defaults held until 2026-10-22 (DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78): 1,000,000 RGB images of 256 × 256 as fixed rows of 192 KiB, 512 to a container of 96 MiB; batch 32 over 8 DataLoader workers each 2 ahead, 500 steps of 105 ms. Placeholders, not measured, and untraced: no application run stands behind them.
